data.short_meaning: She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu
data.long_meaning: She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu, the god of the universe and the god of love. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shambhu' and 'Ika'. Shambhu means 'the god' and 'Ika' means 'one'. So, Shaambhavika means 'She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu'. The name Shaambhavika carries the meaning “She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shaambhavika usually hope their child will grow to embody she who is the embodiment of lord shambhu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shaambhavika is a name that signifies devotion and surrender to the divine. It is a name that inspires one to connect with the divine and seek its blessings. It is also a name that represents the power and strength of the goddess Durga.
data.etymology: Shaambhavika belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu.”
